name: Inquisitor Scout of the Gods
body:
A scout of the gods is a divine spy and thief, combining spherecasting and guile talents to serve his faith.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

The scout of the gods is proficient with simple weapons, as well as light armor and bucklers. In addition, if this is the character’s first level in any class, the scout of the gods may select a martial tradition of his choice.

This alters weapon and armor proficiencies.

Trade Tradition

If this is this character’s first level in any class, the scout of the gods may select a trade tradition of his choice, and have an adroit trade rank.

This replaces the inquisitor’s normal class skills.

Blended Training (Ex)

A scout of the gods gains a [utility] talent that can be spent on combat or skill talents at 1st level and every odd level thereafter. He also gains any combat or skill talent of his choice at 2nd level and every even level thereafter. A scout of the gods uses his operative modifier as his practitioner modifier.

This replaces solo tactics, and the teamwork feats gained at 3rd, 6th, 9th, 12th, 15th, and 18th level.

Divine Detective

At 1st level, the scout of the gods receives a bonus talent of their choice from either the Bluster, Investigation, Scout, or Study spheres. At 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level, he gains another bonus talent from one of these spheres.

This replaces monster lore and stern gaze. A scout of the gods may not exchange these class features if he possesses an archetype that would alter or replace monster lore and/or stern gaze.
